questions.question: Interview ka pehla 2 minute kya decide karta hai?
questions.answer: Problem understanding aur approach clarity. Interviewer dekhta hai: sawal ko clarify kiya? constraints poocha? brute force → better approach ka journey dikhaya? Isliye pehle clarifying questions, phir approach, phir code.
questions.explanation: Clarify → approach → code.

questions.question: AI Engineer vs Data Scientist vs ML Engineer — role boundaries batao.
questions.answer: DS: analysis, experiments, statistics aur business insights. MLE: production systems, deployment, infra, reliability. AI Engineer: LLM/RAG/agent systems, prompt/eval design aur product integration. Overlap zyada hai — job description padho.
questions.explanation: Similarly different focus.

questions.question: Interview me STAR method kab aur kaise use karte hain?
questions.answer: Behavioural questions ke liye: Situation, Task, Action, Result — aur Result me number (latency kam hui, revenue impact, time saved). 60-90 second me ek story, technical depth optional follow-up ke liye rakho.
questions.explanation: Story + measurable result.

questions.question: 'Tell me about yourself' ka structured jawab kya hoga?
questions.answer: 3 parts: ab kya karte ho (current focus), relevant experience ka 1-2 proof point (project + number), aur is role me kyun (specific). 90 second max, resume padhna nahi hai.
questions.explanation: Present → proof → why this role.

questions.question: Interview me 'I don't know' kaise bolna chahiye?
questions.answer: Honestly bolo, phir reasoning dikhao: 'mujhe exact nahi pata, par main aise approach karta — X documentation dekhunga, Y experiment karunga'. Guess ko fact ki tarah mat bolo.
questions.explanation: Unknown + approach > fake confidence.

questions.question: Interview me trade-off bhasha kyun zaroori hai?
questions.answer: Seniority ka signal: 'simple option X, scalable option Y, main Y chununga kyunki data size Z hai' — choice + reason + cost. Sirf 'best practice' bolna weak lagta hai.
questions.explanation: Choice + reason + cost.

questions.question: Coding interview me pehle brute force likhna chahiye ya optimal?
questions.answer: Brute force bolo aur uski complexity batao, phir bottleneck identify karke optimize karo — interviewer ko thinking process dikhta hai. Direct optimal likhna theek hai agar approach pehle verbalize kar do.
questions.explanation: Verbose process, silent coding nahi.

questions.question: Interview me complexity bataate waqt kaunsi galtiyan hoti hain?
questions.answer: Average vs worst case mix karna, hidden costs ignore karna (string concat, sort in loop, dict hashing), aur space complexity bhoolna (recursion stack). Har loop/recursion par explicitly bolo.
questions.explanation: Worst case + hidden cost bolo.

questions.question: ML interview me 'metric kyun chuna' ka jawab kaise dete hain?
questions.answer: Business cost se: false negative mehnga tha → recall-first, aur class imbalance tha → PR-AUC. Phir threshold cost matrix se set kiya. Metric justification mehngi hoti hai sirf accuracy batane se.
questions.explanation: Business cost → metric.

questions.question: System design interview me pehle kya karte ho?
questions.answer: Requirements clarify (functional + non-functional: latency, scale, consistency, budget), rough numbers (QPS, data size), phir high-level boxes, phir deep dive on the critical path. Perfect design nahi, structured reasoning.
questions.explanation: Requirements + numbers pehle.

questions.question: Interview me project explain karne ka best structure kya hai?
questions.answer: Problem + constraint → approach (aur kya options the) → implementation highlights → measured result → what you'd change now. Numbers aur trade-offs se credibility aati hai.
questions.explanation: Problem → trade-off → result.

questions.question: Resume me project bullet kaise likhna chahiye?
questions.answer: Action + technology + measurable outcome: 'Built RAG service over 12k docs with hybrid retrieval; cut support answer time 35% and p95 latency to 400ms'. Ownership verb se shuru karo, responsibility nahi outcome likho.
questions.explanation: Evidence with numbers.

questions.question: Interview me gap ya career switch kaise explain karte hain?
questions.answer: Short, factual, forward-looking: kya kiya us samay (skills, projects, certifications), kya seekha, aur ab role ke liye kyun ready ho. Defensive tone nahi, blame nahi.
questions.explanation: Short + forward-looking.

questions.question: Interview me salary discussion ka approach kya hoga?
questions.answer: Research se range pata karo, ek number ki jagah range + 'role ke scope par depend' bolo, aur total package (bonus, equity, learning) dekho. Pehle apni value ka proof do, phir numbers.
questions.explanation: Range + evidence.

questions.question: Interview me 'do you have questions for us' — kya poochhna chahiye?
questions.answer: Team ka current biggest challenge, success ka definition 6 mahine me, architecture/data stack, on-call aur review culture, aur next steps. Ye poochhna engagement aur seriousness dikhata hai.
questions.explanation: Work aur team ke baare me poochho.

questions.question: Mock interview ka practice loop kaise banate ho?
questions.answer: Timer ke saath bolkar practice (loud), recording suno, feedback rubric (structure/clarity/depth), aur weak areas par targeted drill. Har week 2 mock — generic reading se improvement nahi hoti.
questions.explanation: Speaking practice + feedback loop.

questions.question: Interview me whiteboard/coding task me testing kaise dikhate ho?
questions.answer: Solution likhne ke baad khud edge cases bolo aur test karo: empty input, single element, duplicates, negative/zero, large input. Interviewer ke poochne se pehle karna strong signal hai.
questions.explanation: Self-test with edge cases.

questions.question: Interview me production experience kaise prove karte ho?
questions.answer: Concrete incidents aur numbers: 'rollback 5 min me kiya', 'alert se detect hua', 'p95 900ms se 180ms', 'migration expand-contract se zero downtime'. Stories + metrics > buzzwords.
questions.explanation: Incident stories + metrics.

questions.question: Interview me team conflict ka jawab kaise dena chahiye?
questions.answer: Non-blaming, process-focused: disagreement kya thi, data kisne diya, kaise decide hua (experiment/review), aur relationship kaise maintain hui. Empathy + decisiveness dikhao.
questions.explanation: Data + respect.

questions.question: Final round ke baad follow-up ka kya protocol?
questions.answer: 24 ghante me short thank-you note with one concrete value point ya question ka answer, aur timeline poochho. Zyada follow-up (har din ping) unprofessional lagta hai.
questions.explanation: One concise follow-up.

questions.question: Interview: 'Tumhara sabse challenging project kaunsa tha?' — 90 second answer structure do.
questions.answer: Context (problem + constraint) → mera role aur trade-offs → kya technically hard tha → measured outcome → ab kya better karta. Example: RAG service, table-heavy PDFs par recall low tha, routing + table-aware chunking se 0.6 → 0.86.
questions.explanation: Constraint + decision + number.

questions.question: Interview: 'Ek technical failure batao' — jawab kaise banao ge?
questions.answer: Failure + iska asar + maine kya diagnose kiya + fix + system/process me kya permanent badla. Example: status filter missing se dashboard metric 20% inflated tha → filter fix + regression test + definition doc.
questions.explanation: Failure + permanent fix.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aapne kis cheez ko simplify kiya aur kyun?'
questions.answer: Over-engineered multi-agent setup ko single agent + deterministic state machine me convert kiya kyunki task me single owner tha — result: 40% cost kam, debugging aasan, reliability 3% upar. Simplicity ko result ke saath justify karo.
questions.explanation: Simplify + measured gain.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aap decision kaise lete ho jab data adhoora ho?'
questions.answer: Data jo hai usse baseline banao, reversible option chuno (feature flag/canary), timebox experiment chalao, aur assumption explicitly likho. Data complete hone ka wait mat karo, par andaze ko fact bhi mat banao.
questions.explanation: Reversible + measured assumption.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aapko code review me kya sabse pehle dikhta hai?'
questions.answer: Correctness edge cases, error handling, aur tests; phir naming/readability; performance last (aur only if hot path ho). Review comment me reason aur alternative deta hoon, style nit ko blocking nahi banata.
questions.explanation: Correctness → clarity → perf.

questions.question: Interview: 'Data quality issue mila to aap kya karte ho?'
questions.answer: Quantify (kitne rows/kaunse segments), root cause (upstream change/join/parse), mitigate (filter + report), phir permanent fix (contract + assertion + alert) aur stakeholder ko numbers ke saath update.
questions.explanation: Quantify → cause → fix → communicate.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aapne kisi model ko reject kyun kiya jiska offline score accha tha?'
questions.answer: Latency/cost budget se bahar tha aur interpretability requirement fail karta tha — offline F1 2 point zyada thi par p95 900ms. Simpler model chuna aur threshold tune kiya, production me bhi behtar perform kiya.
questions.explanation: Offline score ≠ production fit.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aapke liye good code kya hai?'
questions.answer: Correct (edge cases handled), readable (names + structure), testable (pure functions, injected deps), observable (logs/metrics), aur boring (no clever tricks). Teen criteria bolkar ek example do.
questions.explanation: Correct + readable + testable.

questions.question: Interview: 'Production me tumhara sabse bada incident?'
questions.answer: Report query ne primary DB ke connection pool exhaust kar diya → mitigation: query limit + read replica; permanent: nightly pre-aggregation, statement timeouts, alert on pool wait. Timeline aur MTTR numbers ke saath bolo.
questions.explanation: Mitigate → permanent fix.

questions.question: Interview: 'Legacy code me change kaise karte ho jahan tests nahi hain?'
questions.answer: Characterization tests pehle (current behaviour document karo), phir chhote refactor steps with green tests, seam introduce karo (dependency inject) aur risky path ko feature flag ke peeche rakho.
questions.explanation: Characterization tests first.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aap estimation kaise karte ho?'
questions.answer: Work ko chhote pieces me todo, unknowns identify karo, aur range do ('2-4 din, agar X API aisa behave kare to 1 din'). Happens events ke baad estimate update karo — ek number pakad kar rakhna unprofessional hai.
questions.explanation: Range + assumptions.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aap prioritization kaise karte ho jab sab kuch urgent ho?'
questions.answer: Impact × effort × risk matrix, aur jo irreversible/reputational risk ho use pehle. Sab kuch urgent nahi hota — stakeholder ke saath explicitly trade-off discuss karta hoon aur outcome measure karta hoon.
questions.explanation: Impact/effort + explicit trade-off.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aap feedback kaise lete ho?'
questions.answer: Curiosity ke saath: specific examples poochho, summarize karke confirm karo, aur ek action lena. Defensiveness se learning band ho jaati hai — 'koi example de sakte ho' powerful question hai.
questions.explanation: Examples + action.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aapki documentation approach kya hai?'
questions.answer: Design doc me problem/options/decision (ADR style), runbook me exact commands, aur README me setup steps. Docs code ke saath versioned aur PR me update hote hain — wiki drift nahi.
questions.explanation: ADR + runbook + README.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aap experimentation (A/B) ke results kaise interpret karte ho?'
questions.answer: Pre-registered metric + sample size, novelty effect, segmentation, aur guardrail metrics. Statistical significance ke saath practical significance bhi dekho (3% lift chhoti sample par meaningless).
questions.explanation: Pre-register + practical significance.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aap AI/LLM ke output ko trustworthy kaise banate ho?'
questions.answer: Grounding (retrieval + citations), abstention threshold, structured output validation, aur eval suite with regression gates. Trust build hota hai verification se, claim se nahi.
questions.explanation: Ground + evaluate.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aapko naya domain 2 hafte me pick karna hai — plan kya hoga?'
questions.answer: Week 1: docs/papers skim + ek end-to-end tutorial chalao + team se 3 sawal (jahan biggest gotchas hain). Week 2: ek chhota real task deliver karo + runbook/document gaps note karo. Learn by shipping.
questions.explanation: Skim → build → ship small.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aapki team ko tumse kya process change mila?'
questions.answer: Eval harness + regression gate (ML changes ke liye), aur incident runbooks. Result: regressions production me 60% kam, on-call pages actionable. Process change ko outcome se justify karo.
questions.explanation: Process + measured outcome.

questions.question: Interview: 'Mentoring me tum kya karte ho?'
questions.answer: Pairing sessions, review me explanation (kyun, sirf kya nahi), aur stretch task with safety net. Mentor ka success metric mentee ka independence hai, tumhari dependency nahi.
questions.explanation: Independence as outcome.

questions.question: Interview: 'Aap ethics/PII ke saath model development kaise karte ho?'
questions.answer: Data minimization, consent/legal check, PII redaction in logs/prompts, bias evaluation per segment, aur documented limitations. Ye baad me add karne wala feature nahi, design constraint hai.
questions.explanation: Design constraint, not afterthought.

questions.question: What makes a smart answer?
questions.answer: Specific, truthful, structured and easy to follow. WHY Tie claims to your real work. Mastery: Explain without notes + solve one fresh problem + predict two outputs + tell one edge case. 165
questions.explanation: Pehle output predict karo, phir compare karo.

questions.question: Model routing ko kaise design karoge?
questions.answer: Task complexity, latency budget, privacy, modality, context requirement, expected quality aur cost ko routing signals banaunga. Route decision deterministic rules + benchmark data se tune karunga.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: RAG me query rewriting kya hai?
questions.answer: User query ko retrieval-friendly form me transform karna, jaise missing keywords add karna ya ambiguous references clarify karna. Rewrite ko answer claim nahi samajhna chahiye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: HyDE style retrieval ka idea kya hai?
questions.answer: Model se hypothetical relevant passage banwa kar uska embedding retrieve ke liye use karna. Isse semantic recall improve ho sakta hai, lekin hallucinated query drift ko evaluate karna zaroori hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Parent-child retrieval kya solve karta hai?
questions.answer: Small child chunks precision improve karte hain aur parent document broader context provide karta hai. Retrieval unit aur generation context ko alag rakhne ka pattern hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: RAG me ACL kaise preserve karoge?
questions.answer: Ingestion par permission metadata attach karo, retrieval me mandatory authorization filters lagao, aur tool/data access layer par second enforcement rakho.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: RAG freshness SLA kya hota hai?
questions.answer: Define karo ki source update ke kitne time andar index reflect karega. Freshness timestamp monitor karo aur stale results par fallback ya warning design karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Retriever recall high but answer quality low kyun?
questions.answer: Relevant document retrieved ho sakta hai lekin context packing, ordering, contradictory sources, model instruction ya evidence selection fail ho sakte hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Context packing kya hai?
questions.answer: Retrieved evidence ko order, deduplicate, compress aur source metadata ke saath model context me arrange karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Lost-in-the-middle problem ko kaise reduce karoge?
questions.answer: Relevant evidence ko carefully position karo, context size limit karo, summarize/rerank karo aur critical evidence ko final prompt structure me high-salience placement do.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: RAG me duplicate chunks problem?
questions.answer: Same semantic content ko near-duplicate removal, MMR/diversity selection aur document-level dedupe se reduce karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Tool latency aggregation kaise samjho?
questions.answer: Sequential calls latency add karte hain; independent calls parallel ho sakte hain. Trace spans se critical path identify karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Tool timeout ka default behavior?
questions.answer: Bounded timeout, cancellation, retry only for safe/idempotent operations, aur user-facing degraded response define karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Retry storm kya hai?
questions.answer: Multiple layers ek hi failure ko retry karein to traffic multiply ho sakta hai. Central retry policy, jitter, budgets aur circuit breakers use karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Idempotency key ka practical example?
questions.answer: Payment/refund/order-write request me client-generated key store karo; same key repeat hone par same prior result return karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Saga pattern AI workflows me kab?
questions.answer: Multi-step distributed side effects me transaction impossible ho to compensating actions ke saath saga-style workflow use kar sakte ho.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Human approval ko model se kyun nahi karwana?
questions.answer: Approval ka purpose independent control boundary banana hai; same model ko apne action ko approve karne dena separation of duties weak karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Agent budget kya hai?
questions.answer: Per-run limits such as max steps, tool calls, tokens, wall-clock time and spend. Budget exceed par controlled stop/fallback.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Agent termination conditions?
questions.answer: Goal satisfied, verifier pass, explicit user stop, max budget, deadline, repeated-state/cycle detection ya safety policy block.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Verifier agent ka role?
questions.answer: Generated result ya action ko independent criteria ke against check karna. Verifier ko same failure mode reproduce karne se bachane ke liye diverse checks useful hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Critic vs verifier difference?
questions.answer: Critic suggestions/quality feedback deta hai; verifier binary/structured validity decision de sakta hai. Real system me dono combine ho sakte hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Agent memory me privacy issue?
questions.answer: Har memory item ko user consent, retention, purpose, access scope aur delete/update semantics ke through govern karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Memory poisoning kya hai?
questions.answer: Malicious ya incorrect stored memory future decisions influence kare. Write validation, provenance, confidence and user-visible memory controls useful hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Multi-agent communication protocol kya define kare?
questions.answer: Message schema, sender identity, allowed recipients, payload limits, correlation ID, timeout, retry policy and termination semantics.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Supervisor agent bottleneck kaise reduce?
questions.answer: Parallel specialization, static routing for obvious cases, bounded delegation and batching. Supervisor ko every micro- step decide na karne do.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Agent observability me trace hierarchy?
questions.answer: Request trace ke andar model, retrieval, tool, policy, verifier aur external API spans. Har span me latency, status aur safe metadata.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Quality regression after model upgrade?
questions.answer: Golden eval suite rerun, segmented slices compare, critical business flows gate karo aur canary deployment use karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Prompt regression after tool schema change?
questions.answer: Tool-call eval cases aur contract tests rerun karo; invalid-argument rate, tool selection accuracy and downstream outcomes compare karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Eval set leakage kya hai?
questions.answer: Agar test cases prompt/training/optimization loop me repeatedly expose ho jayein to test score unrealistic ho sakta hai. Holdout sets maintain karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Synthetic eval data ka risk?
questions.answer: Synthetic data coverage fast badhata hai, lekin distribution bias ya unrealistic cases aa sakte hain. Human-labeled holdout mix karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: LLM-as-a-judge ka limitation?
questions.answer: Judge bhi model bias/error carry kar sakta hai. Rubric, calibration, pairwise checks and human sampling se validate karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Data scientist ke liye calibration kyun?
questions.answer: Predicted probabilities ko observed frequencies ke saath align karne ke liye. Risk thresholds aur decision policies me calibration useful hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Precision-recall threshold kaise choose?
questions.answer: Business false-positive vs false-negative cost ko define karke validation set par threshold tune karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Drift alert kaise avoid false positives?
questions.answer: Seasonality, expected promotions aur known distribution shifts model karo; baseline window aur alert hysteresis use karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Feature store ka core idea?
questions.answer: Reusable, governed features ko consistent training aur online inference use cases ke liye manage karna. Offline/online consistency important hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Point-in-time correctness kya hai?
questions.answer: Historical training row ke timestamp par jo information available thi sirf wahi join honi chahiye; future leakage avoid karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Backfill kaise safe karoge?
questions.answer: Idempotent transforms, versioned inputs, partition-scoped reruns, data quality checks and downstream impact review.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Late-arriving dimension kya problem hai?
questions.answer: Fact event dimension record se pehle aa sakta hai; pipeline ko surrogate/default key ya delayed enrichment strategy chahiye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Slowly changing dimension Type 2?
questions.answer: Har historical change ka new row/version maintain karke valid_from/valid_to jaise timestamps se history preserve karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Partition pruning kya hai?
questions.answer: Query filters se irrelevant partitions/files skip karna, scan cost reduce karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Small files problem kya hai?
questions.answer: Bahut chhoti files metadata overhead aur read inefficiency create karti hain. Compaction/optimize strategy use hoti hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Data skew ka fix?
questions.answer: Salting, skew-aware joins, repartitioning, broadcast where appropriate, and key redesign depending on workload.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: CDC delete handling?
questions.answer: Delete events preserve karo ya tombstone semantics use karo; sink table ko delete/soft-delete policy ke saath synchronize karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Schema registry kyun?
questions.answer: Event schemas ko version aur compatibility rules ke saath manage karne ke liye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Backward compatible schema change?
questions.answer: Naya producer/consumer old clients ko break na kare. Optional fields and compatible type evolution preferred.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Data observability kya track kare?
questions.answer: Freshness, volume, distribution, schema, nulls, duplicates, lineage and downstream incidents.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Semantic layer kyun?
questions.answer: Business metrics ko consistent definitions aur reusable dimensions ke saath expose karne ke liye, so BI and AI agree on meaning.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Metric contract kya hai?
questions.answer: Metric name, formula, grain, filters, owner, update cadence and source-of-truth explicitly define karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Funnel drop-off kaise diagnose?
questions.answer: Step-wise conversion, segment breakdown, cohort comparison and event instrumentation audit. Aggregate rate se cause assume mat karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Cohort analysis kya?
questions.answer: Users ko common start event/time ke basis par group karke retention/revenue behavior over time compare karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: RFM analysis kya?
questions.answer: Recency, frequency, monetary value ke basis par customers segment karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: A/B test interference kya hai?
questions.answer: One user ka treatment doosre users ke outcome ko affect kare. Network effects/social features me independent-unit assumption fail ho sakti hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Experiment guardrail metric?
questions.answer: Primary goal ke saath safety/business health metric, jaise churn, latency, refunds or support tickets, jisse harmful trade-off detect ho.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Causal inference vs prediction?
questions.answer: Prediction future outcome estimate karta hai; causal inference treatment/intervention effect estimate karta hai. Objective aur assumptions different hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Feature importance vs causality?
questions.answer: Important predictive feature hona causal effect prove nahi karta. Correlated proxy bhi high importance de sakta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Data engineer aur AI engineer handoff?
questions.answer: Data engineer reliable contracts, quality, lineage and serving interfaces deta hai; AI engineer retrieval/model/tool logic ko consume karke application behavior build karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Production schema migration ka safe approach?
questions.answer: Versioned migration, backward compatibility window, dual-read/write where needed, validation and rollback plan.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Canary AI deployment me kya compare?
questions.answer: Error rate, task success, safety violations, latency, cost, tool-call failures and business KPIs by traffic slice.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Disaster recovery for AI system?
questions.answer: Versioned artifacts, durable data, backups, restore drills, fallback provider/model, RPO/RTO definitions and tested runbooks.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: RPO vs RTO?
questions.answer: RPO = kitna data loss acceptable; RTO = service ko kitni der me restore karna target hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Blue-green vs canary?
questions.answer: Blue-green full environment switch pattern; canary gradual traffic exposure pattern. Risk and rollback workflow differ.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Load shedding kya hai?
questions.answer: Overload me low-priority work reject/defer karke critical traffic preserve karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Backpressure kya hai?
questions.answer: Fast producer ko slow consumer ke rate ke according control karna; queues, flow control and admission limits use hote hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Queue ordering guarantee kaise choose?
questions.answer: Business requirement ke hisaab se global ordering, partition/key ordering or no ordering. Strong ordering throughput reduce kar sakta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Exactly-once ko interview me kaise explain?
questions.answer: End-to-end property hai, sirf broker feature nahi. Usually idempotent processing, transactional writes and replay- safe design se practical exactly-once effects achieve karte hain.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: SQL window function kab?
questions.answer: Running totals, ranking, lag/lead, retention calculations aur row-level analytics ke liye.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: AI analytics copilot me SQL safety?
questions.answer: Read-only role, allowlisted schemas, query parser/validator, row/scan limits, timeout and result-size caps.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Text-to-SQL hallucination ka control?
questions.answer: Semantic schema context + constrained generation + SQL parser + allowlist + dry-run/EXPLAIN + result validation.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Agentic Text-to-SQL ka extra risk?
questions.answer: Agent query generate, execute aur iterate kar sakta hai; execution permissions aur budget ko tightly gate karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Why not expose raw DB credentials to agent?
questions.answer: Credentials broad privilege aur data exfiltration risk create karte hain. Scoped service identity/tool gateway safer boundary hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Tool gateway kya hai?
questions.answer: Central policy-enforcing layer jo tool definitions, auth, rate limits, logging, schema validation aur routing manage karti hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Policy engine ka role?
questions.answer: Allowed actions ko user, tenant, environment, tool and risk level ke basis par decide karna.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Auditability ka minimum?
questions.answer: Who, what, when, which policy, which tool, outcome and approval - safe metadata ke saath traceable record.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Reproducibility kya?
questions.answer: Same model/prompt/tool/data/config versions ke saath result behavior ko rerun aur compare kar pana.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Artifact registry me kya store?
questions.answer: Model/version, prompt/config, evaluation results, dependency metadata, deployment status and rollback target.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Embedding index reproducibility?
questions.answer: Embedding model/version, chunker config, preprocessing, metadata schema and index parameters version karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Agent benchmark kaise banega?
questions.answer: Representative task set + expected outcomes + allowed tools + success criteria + adversarial cases + cost/latency budget.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Tool selection accuracy kaise measure?
questions.answer: Expected tool vs selected tool compare karo, wrong-tool rate aur downstream success rate separately track karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Agent handoff loop kaise detect?
questions.answer: Correlation IDs and state history se repeated agent transitions detect karo; max handoffs and cycle rules lagao.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: MCP tool catalog cache kyun?
questions.answer: Tool discovery response cache karne se repeated listing overhead reduce ho sakta hai; current MCP 2026 spec list responses ko cache hints ke saath support karta hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: MCP stateless architecture ka benefit?
questions.answer: Ordinary HTTP load balancing aur horizontal scaling easier ho sakta hai because protocol session affinity requirement remove hui.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: MCP skill content ko trusted instructions maana chahiye?
questions.answer: Nahi. Current Skills extension explicitly prompt-injection risk ke perspective se served skill content ko untrusted input treat karti hai.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: MCP server trust model?
questions.answer: Connected server ko automatically trusted business authority mat samjho; origin, authorization, capability scope and user approvals define karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Long-running agent ko kaise resume?
questions.answer: Checkpointed state + deterministic resume boundary + idempotent side effects + run identity use karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Background agent UX kya hona chahiye?
questions.answer: Immediate acknowledgement + job ID/status + progress events + cancel/retry + final result notification.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: AI system ka error budget?
questions.answer: Reliability budget define karo; frequent errors/retries/cost spikes par feature rollout slow ya rollback kar sakte ho.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Agent cost attribution kaise?
questions.answer: Trace level par model tokens, tool/API cost, retrieval calls and compute time aggregate karke tenant/project attribution karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Evaluation me segmentation kyun?
questions.answer: Average score hidden failures hide kar sakta hai. Language, customer tier, task type, document type and adversarial slice by slice inspect karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: Human review sampling kaise?
questions.answer: Random + risk-based sampling combine karo. High-impact/low-confidence outputs ko higher review probability do.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.

questions.question: What is a safe fallback?
questions.answer: Aisa deterministic/degraded response jo wrong action na le aur user ko next safe step de. Fallback ko evaluate aur monitor karo.
questions.explanation: Playbook ke related section se verify karo.
